QUOTE: `archivedChannelsViewable(value)` is `value !== 'false'` (`app/queries/servers/system.ts:304`). Only the exact string `'false'` turns the feature off. `true`, any other string, and `undefined` all turn it on. ... `archivedChannelsViewable(undefined)` returns `true`. So the app behaves as if the feature is enabled

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a missing setting (undefined) yields viewable archived channels and only the explicit 'false' string disables the feature.
